passages.provision_quote: A social media company shall post terms of service for each social media platform owned or operated by the company in a manner reasonably designed to inform all users of the social media platform of the existence and contents of the terms of service.
passages.note: AB 587 mandates terms-of-service disclosure and moderation-practice reporting, not removal, labeling, voluntary standards, or the free-speech/no-government-role axis the rungs order.

rows.reasoning: AB 587 (2021-2022), authored by Gabriel and signed into law, requires social media companies to publicly disclose their terms of service and report content-moderation data to the Attorney General; it does not require platforms to remove false information, label false content, encourage voluntary standards, protect free speech, or ban government involvement, so no rung on this ladder is established.
